title: CLI and GitHub Action refused every function flow: the embedded runner did not declare contract_nodes
summary: Echopoint shipped input/output contract nodes for function flows to prod at 15:05 UTC (echopoint#927) and refuses an ephemeral claim of such a flow unless the runner declares `contract_nodes`. The capability arrived in runner v0.118.0, but every CLI release that day (v6.0.0 to v7.0.0) embeds runner v0.117.0 or older. So `echopoint flow run` and the GitHub Action got 409 `RUNNER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED` for every function flow, and for any flow that calls one. The flow-coverage routine found it at 18:14 UTC while writing the gate flow for #927. echopoint-cli#114 embeds runner v0.119.0 and tests every gated capability.

impact.text: Function flows with contract nodes could not run from the CLI or the GitHub Action on prod. Cloud and self-hosted runners were not affected. No customer reported it; the feature was hours old.

numbers.label: function flows unrunnable from the CLI and Action
CLI releases shipped without the capability
gate flows that ran a function flow on the CLI

trigger: echopoint#927 reached prod at 15:05 UTC with a claim gate on `contract_nodes`, which no released CLI declared.
detection: The echopoint-investigation routine got the 409 at 18:14 UTC on the first CLI run of its new gate flow for #927. No alert covers RUNNER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED refusals.
resolution: echopoint-cli#114 embeds runner v0.119.0, which declares `contract_nodes`; its release lets `flow run` claim function flows.

events.detail: Execution 01a1fa2b-301a-76e1-a436-050a52df8077: `This flow uses input or output contract nodes, and the runner that claimed it cannot execute them.`

events.label: Cause found: CLI binary has no contract_nodes string

whys.problem: `echopoint flow run` and the GitHub Action could not run any function flow on prod

because.text: The CLI's ephemeral claim did not declare contract_nodes, so Echopoint refused it with 409
because.evidence: Claim response `RUNNER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED … declares contract_nodes`; CLI v7.0.0 binary has no `contract_nodes` string

because.text: CLI v7.0.0 embeds runner v0.117.0; the capability was declared in v0.118.0
because.evidence: `go version -m echopoint`: runner v0.117.0; runner#135 tagged v0.118.0 at 15:06

because.text: Runner, CLI and Echopoint PRs of one feature merged within 40 min; CLI#112 pinned the runner tag that existed when it was opened
Echopoint gated a node type on a capability before any released CLI declared it, and nothing checks that order
because.evidence: workspace AGENTS.md covers only the reverse order (runner declares before Echopoint accepts)

because.text: No check or rule requires a released CLI and Action to declare a capability before Echopoint gates a node type on it
CLI CI passed because its capability test asserted only secret_outputs
The test was written for the first capability and never grew with form_body, email_wait or contract_nodes
The CLI test pinned one capability instead of the set Echopoint gates on
It went unnoticed for 3 h because no gate flow ran a function flow on the CLI runner
because.evidence: #927 added CT only; no prod-org flow had an `input` node before 18:14

because.text: The gate runs flows on the CLI, but #927 shipped no gate flow for its new node types
A PR that adds a runner node type is not required to ship a gate flow that runs it on the CLI runner

contributing: Three CLI majors (v6.0.0, v6.1.0, v7.0.0) shipped within 40 min, each focused on publish removal, not capabilities.

well: Echopoint's refusal message named the missing capability, so the cause took minutes to find.
The gate fails closed: no CLI ran a contract node it could not execute.
wrong: The capability gate went to prod with no client able to pass it on the ephemeral path.
The CLI capability test checked one of four capabilities.
lucky: The feature was hours old and had no known users; a gate on an existing node type would have broken running CI pipelines.
The routine wrote a gate flow for #927 the same day.

actions.what: Embed runner v0.119.0 and assert every gated capability in the CLI claim test
Workspace AGENTS.md rule: an Echopoint PR that gates a node type on a capability merges after a released CLI declares it
Echopoint CI check: every RunnerCapability the server gates is declared by the latest released CLI (fail before merge)
Gate flow `Function flow contract nodes` runs a function flow on the CLI runner (echopoint tag)
Alert when prod answers RUNNER_UPGRADE_REQUIRED to a released CLI version

messaging.internal: Function flows (contract nodes) could not run from the CLI/Action since #927: CLI v7.0.0 embeds runner v0.117.0 without contract_nodes. echopoint-cli#114 ships runner v0.119.0; run `echopoint update`.
messaging.external: None: no known users of function flows yet.
